name: nf_studies_search_config
description: Search configuration for the nf-studies SearchIndex, syn75081633. Default analyzer is the built-in STANDARD (tokenize + lowercase, no stemming) so names/free-text stay searchable; per-column overrides (org.synapse.nf-nf_studies_columns) route id fields to IDENTIFIER, discovery free-text (summary, manifestation, diseaseFocus) to the nf_scientific_synonyms analyzer, and clean categorical/facet fields to KEYWORD. Bind only to syn75081633.
